Creates a permanent device identity and switches to managed VPN. Manual profile import and removal will be locked; saved profiles stay. Use your operator’s HTTPS server. Choose the encrypted configuration file issued for this registered device. Its signature will be verified before changing VPN profiles. The app will connect VPN after applying it. Disconnect any active VPN first.

Could not apply configuration. Keep the device identity and app data for recovery.

Fetch signed configuration for this registered device from the pinned Family Connect relay. VPN will connect after verification. Configuration and confirmation delivery retry every minute until Disconnect.
